name: KnowledgeVault Cold Start
purpose: Orient a new human or agent to KnowledgeVault without relying on prior chat context.

included_files.reason: Public front door and repo purpose.
Agent operating contract and safety rules.
Agent database model, retrieval rules, and quality gates.
Canonical note shape and formatting standard.

freshness_notes: Repo, PR, CI, release, and runtime capability claims must be verified against the owning source before action.
This bundle is for orientation; it should not be treated as proof that any feature is wired or tested.
safety_notes: Do not add local-only private files to this bundle.
Do not infer private project state from omitted files.

known_unverified_claims: Current GitHub state is not embedded in this bundle.
Runtime capability status must be checked in the owning runtime repo.
